items.author: wildwheelshat.bsky.social
items.context: Does anyone know, if I downloaded a game via the Epic Games Store thing do I still need the launcher to start it. Got Death Stranding in a humble bundle that claimed via Epic and I kinda wanna get Epic games stuff off my PC.
items.text: Most games claimed through Epic start through the Epic launcher, though a few are DRM-free and run on their own. Worth checking before you uninstall it, since it depends on the game.
items.verify: Нужен ли лаунчер Epic для Death Stranding, проверьте: у части игр он обязателен, у части нет.
